title: CausalNode
description: Schema for an event node in the Multi-Parent Causal Event DAG.

event_id.description: Unique identifier for the causal event node.

parent_ids.description: List of parent event IDs representing causal preconditions.

tick.description: Discrete simulation world tick when event occurred.

actor.description: Actor executing the event (e.g., worker_alpha, worker_beta, host_environment, stochastic_shock).

action_name.description: Name of action primitive or event trigger.

state_delta.description: Key-value state mutations produced by this event.

parent_hash.description: Combined SHA-256 hash of all parent node hashes.

node_hash.description: Cryptographic SHA-256 hash of this node.
